content: new 2026-08-26 — nhlbi.nih.gov/sitemap.xml is a sitemap INDEX whose sub-sitemaps paginate as 'sitemap.xml?page=N' (not '.xml' filenames) — src/collectors/sitemap.py's index-recursion previously only detected an index by guessing '.endswith(".xml")' on the first URL, which silently failed here and would have returned 0 items forever. Fixed 2026-08-26 to detect index-vs-leaf from the actual XML structure instead (presence of <sitemap> elements), and to stop pre-filtering sub-sitemap URLs by filter_path (a sub-sitemap's filename, e.g. niddk's 'sitemap-sc.xml', routinely has nothing to do with the topics inside it). Verified live post-fix: real body text (e.g. /ask-a-scientist/sleep-important, /ask-a-scientist/enough-sleep, body_len ~640-650). Supplements the existing nhlbi_sleep html_crawl surface. NOTE: same fix also unblocks fda.gov's sitemap mechanically, but verified live that FDA's general sitemap.xml mostly indexes /media/NNNNN/download (warning letters etc.), not nutrition content pages — filter_path='nutrition' found 0 matches across all its ?page=N sub-sitemaps, so no fda_*_sitemap surface was added; the existing fda_nutrition html_crawl surface already covers FDA directly.
